# `mise bootstrap repos exec`

- **Usage:** `mise bootstrap repos exec [-c --continue-on-error] [-n --dry-run] [PATH]… <-- COMMAND>…`
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/bootstrap.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/bootstrap.rs)

Run a command in each configured Git repository

Put the command and its arguments after `--`. Paths before `--` select
repositories. The command runs directly, without a shell, so pipes and `&&`
do not work. Missing or conflicting repositories are skipped with a
warning. Use `--continue-on-error` to visit the rest after a failure.

## Arguments
- **`[PATH]…`** — Run only in repositories at these paths, as written in config or expanded
- **`<-- COMMAND>…`** — Command and arguments to run in each repository

## Flags
- **`-c --continue-on-error`** — Continue running in other repositories after a command fails
- **`-n --dry-run`** — Print the commands that would run without running them
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Show uncommitted changes in every repository

```
mise bootstrap repos exec -- git status --short
```

Run a command in one repository

```
mise bootstrap repos exec ~/src/mise -- git log -1
```

Fetch every repository, even after one fails

```
mise bootstrap repos exec --continue-on-error -- git fetch
```
